rationale: The workshop door sensor (SEN-D1) is the only offline device while all other sensors from the same box are online, ruling out a base-station or setup problem. It has a fresh battery (75%), good signal (-60 dBm), and compatible firmware (v3 supported), yet shows no LED activity at all during a 5-second reset held directly next to the base station. A sensor that is completely dark with a new battery and good signal indicates a hardware fault requiring L2/FAE escalation.
